$note: Sync stamp for the vendored KnowledgeNetwork Design System snapshot. The DS is a Claude Design project with NO native version/release and NO per-file hashes in its manifest, so this file IS the diffable version marker of what state we adopted. To check for drift: re-read the DS via /design-sync, re-hash, and compare against `tokens.files` below; to adopt a change, re-vendor and update the hashes + syncedAt here. Graduating to a properly published/semver'd dependency is tracked in issue #66.

tokens.note: Byte-identical copies of the DS tokens/*.css. These hashes ARE the DS token-file fingerprints; a mismatch on re-hash means the DS changed. base.css + fonts.css are vendored but not yet imported (held for #64).

components.note: Typed .tsx ports of the DS .jsx sources (NOT byte-identical — jsx→tsx adaptation). The prop contract each is ported against is the DS .d.ts, machine-enforced by _adherence.oxlintrc.json (ported into ESLint at #61). Drift-check a port by re-reading its `from` source and comparing behaviour.
